meta.name: WealthSmith Icon Registry
meta.description: Approved WealthSmith MVP icon assets and usage metadata.

categories.ui: General product interface icons, including chart-related UI icons such as chart-pie.
categories.chart: Chart legend and chart series marker icons only.
categories.token: Token/asset icons. Always pair with token symbol or name. Uses fallback-token when missing.
categories.wallet: Wallet provider icons. Exact approved assets only; no fallback for MVP.
categories.protocol: Protocol/platform icons. Exact approved assets only; no fallback for MVP.

globalRules: Use SVG assets, not screenshots, in production.
Do not invent icon names or paths.
Do not show broken image icons.
Important icons must have visible text or accessible labels.
Token, wallet, and protocol icons must not be the only source of identity.
Only token icons use a fallback for MVP.
Wallet and protocol logos are exact approved assets; missing assets are implementation issues.
Chart marker icons must always be paired with visible series labels.
chart-pie.svg belongs to UI icons, not chart marker icons.
Do not create a separate status icon folder for MVP.
Do not use icons to imply recommendation, custody, execution, or guaranteed returns.
